plugin.summary: Addressed every finding in reviews.fields and reviews.forms in plugin/heartland-k9s-core (version bumped to 1.0.1). Fields: Select sanitizer now returns the default for any non-option value (incl. ''), the '— Select —' placeholder is only offered when the default is '' (an empty value shows the default selected); Icon validates only against a real sprite list (Helpers::sprite_icon_names()/icon_list_available(); empty list is never cached; without a list any sanitize_key name is kept and the picker offers FALLBACK ∪ current value); aria-describedby on Image/Gallery/File buttons and the Relationship search only when help exists (Type::describedby()); Repeater 'min' → schema minItems + sanitizer pads missing rows from the default rows/empty rows (capped at max); collection-route defaults fixed via a rest_prepare_page filter (absent keys → the page's own template defaults, private keys stripped outside edit) and prepare_callback honours $request['template']; new Fields\Access applied on the write paths (Sections Registry::rest_pre_insert, Sections MetaBox::save, Meta Registry::rest_pre_insert, Meta MetaBox::save) zeroing relationship ids / link post_ids the current user cannot edit_post unless already stored (sanitizers stay pure); Layout::reference() (declaration order + hidden_default ids) counts as a default write and rest_pre_insert/is_default_write/template_default take the request's template (Accessor::resolve_template) when a PUT switches it. Forms: token is claimed atomically (Antispam::claim: add_option row insert / wp_cache_add) only after validation and released on send_failed, which now returns a refresh token; new GET hk9/v1/forms/{id}/token → {nonce,ts,token} with no-store headers and forms-frontend.js refreshes hidden fields at init (data-hk9-token); no-JS path: template_redirect sends nocache_headers()+DONOTCACHEPAGE for ?hk9_form= results and for singular pages whose layout contains a form/application_form section (Handler::page_renders_form + filter), render() repeats it; forms.trusted_proxies (cidrs, off by default) + forms.proxy_header (default X-Forwarded-For) in Settings\Schema/Store/Page (Forms tab), Antispam::client_ip() reads the header only when REMOTE_ADDR is a trusted proxy (right-most untrusted hop wins, v4/v6 CIDR); Mailer fires do_action('hk9/forms/mail_failed', $submission_id, WP_Error, $form_id) and logs the empty-recipient case; Submissions shows a dismissible admin notice (dashboard + plugin screens) counting _hk9_mail_sent=0 in the last 7 days with a 'Notification failed' list view/filter (hk9_mail=failed), dismissal per user re-armed by newer failures; failed-POST transients carry no typed values for unknown_form/nonce/honeypot/token/expired, values capped at 2000 chars, and the retention cron purges expired hk9_form_* option rows; retention query includes trash; rate-limit key no longer rolls at UTC midnight; JS falls back to native submit whenever the response lacks the {ok,mode} envelope; '* Required' legend, a single autofocus per page (error transient deleted on shutdown so a second copy still renders values), translatable placeholders, neutral duplicate message.

plugin.integration_notes: New REST route GET hk9/v1/forms/{id}/token (public, no-store) used by assets/js/forms-frontend.js at init via the form's data-hk9-token attribute; the JS also sends X-WP-Nonce when HK9.forms.restNonce is set so logged-in users get a nonce for their own session. New settings forms.trusted_proxies (type 'cidrs', one IP/CIDR per line, off when empty) and forms.proxy_header (type 'header', default X-Forwarded-For) on the Forms tab; the theme's inc/defaults.php does not need them (plugin-only). Theme should style .hk9-form__required-note. Helpers::icon_names()/hk9_icon_name_list() keep returning the reference list when the sprite is missing (theme pickers unchanged); Icon fields now use Helpers::sprite_icon_names()/icon_list_available() and only validate when a real list exists. Sections\\Registry gained rest_prepare_page handling, template_from_request(), template_default(..., ?string $template) and is_default_write(..., ?string $template); Accessor::resolve_template($file, $post_id) is the shared template-slug resolver; Layout::reference($definitions) gives the template reference layout. Antispam::claim()/release()/duplicate()/ip_in_list() are new (mark_used() kept for BC). Submissions::run_retention() now also runs purge_expired_transients() and includes trashed posts; Submissions::mail_failures() is cached 5 minutes (cleared by record_mail on failure). Handler::RESULT_PREFIX is now public. Plugin version 1.0.1 (header + HK9_CORE_VERSION).

theme.summary:
Addressed every reviews.theme finding (10/10) and bumped the theme to 1.0.1.

N+1 / bounded queries (inc/template-tags-records.php): new hk9_rec_prime() (posts + meta + featured-image posts/meta in 2–4 batched queries), hk9_rec_query() now calls update_post_thumbnail_cache() and defaults posts_per_page to hk9_rec_query_limit() (filter `hk9/theme/rec_query_limit`, default 200, instead of -1); hk9_rec_by_ids() primes meta + thumbnails; hk9_rec_gallery() primes attachments before the wp_attachment_is_image() filter; hk9_rec_events() primes thumbnails on the plugin path and the plugin-less fallback is now a bounded WP_Query (posts_per_page => $count, meta_query on hk9_end/hk9_start vs current_time('Y-m-d H:i') with the no-end branch, ordered by hk9_start) instead of loading every event and filtering in PHP; campaigns_list.php collects all sponsor ids from raw meta and primes them once before the card loop; gallery_options.php primes the image ids referenced by the page's gallery block before the_content(); template-tags-pages.php story helpers prime too. Measured after wp_cache_flush() via hk9_rec_render_sections(): teams 10→9, campaigns 27→14, people 31→12, partners 37→14, stories 16→13, events 9→9, photos gallery 147→9 (71 images). Remaining counts are fixed per page (page meta, options, listing query, 2 record batches, 2 thumbnail batches, CTA link lookups) — no per-record growth.

Social/brand icons: assets/dist/icons.svg did NOT contain facebook/instagram/youtube/linkedin — they had been added ad hoc in inc/icons.php (hk9_icon_brand_extras(), lucide outline copies) and X mapped to a non-existent 'brand-x'. Moved them into tools/build-icons.mjs as embedded CC0 Simple Icons paths (fetched verbatim from simple-icons@16.30.0; linkedin from 13.21.0, the last release that shipped it — Simple Icons removed LinkedIn in v14 at the brand owner's request, documented), emitted as filled symbols (fill="currentColor" stroke="none") and a distinct `x-social` symbol; the script now also writes docs/licenses/LICENSE-simple-icons.txt (provenance + CC0 text). Rebuilt: 39 lucide symbols unchanged + 5 brand symbols (44 total, icons.json updated). Removed hk9_icon_brand_extras() from icons.php. footer.php: X → 'x-social'; the screen-reader label span is emitted only when an icon renders, otherwise the visible text label alone.

FAQ: reference has no accordion — kept native <details>, removed the dead data-hk9-accordion attribute and initAccordions() from theme.js (rebuilt, 2.1 kB). i18n: all hk9_rec_section_defaults() strings wrapped in __(); CTA links resolve via new hk9_rec_settings_link('links.donate'|'links.volunteer'|'forms.application_success_page', label, fallback path) using the footer's page-exists rule. BarKode: role="alert" removed, text now <strong> with `strong { font-weight: inherit }` so the visual is unchanged. Removed the no-op wp_lazy_loading_enabled filter + misleading comment from inc/assets.php. Menus: hk9_primary_menu() no longer calls wp_get_nav_menu_items(); the last top-level id is computed in a wp_nav_menu_objects filter (verified the divider class still lands on the last desktop item). Hero fragments: hk9_rec_hero() now runs badge and meta items through hk9_rec_fragment() (wp_kses with span + the SVG subset the sprite uses; viewBox case restored) — all 44 sprite icons round-trip unchanged apart from `/>` spacing; onclick/script/img/javascript: stripped.

Version: style.css Version 1.0.1, HK9_THEME_VERSION 1.0.1, readme Stable tag 1.0.1 + changelog + Simple Icons licence line, window.HK9.version 1.0.1. npm run build:css && build:js clean; php -l (PHP 8.5.2) clean on every touched file.

Visual regression: 14 of 16 route/width captures differ by 0.00–0.02%. home-1440 = 0.98%: (a) the footer Facebook glyph (intentional outline→filled Simple Icons), (b) the BarKode feature image — the ARCHIVED capture has that lazy image unloaded (blank navy card) while the new capture shows it loaded, i.e. a timing artefact in the archive, not a regression. contact 390/1440 = +64px / ~8%: caused by a new "* Required" note the forms agent added to plugin/heartland-k9s-core/src/Forms/Renderer.php (uncommitted, outside my area), not by theme changes.

The plugin-less events fallback can only return rows when something registers hk9_event without the plugin; with the plugin off the CPT is absent, so the bounded query was validated by running the identical WP_Query with the plugin on (LIMIT 0, 6; correct past/upcoming split).

theme.integration_notes: New theme API: hk9_rec_prime(int[] $ids) (posts+meta+thumbnails), hk9_rec_query_limit($post_type) with filter `hk9/theme/rec_query_limit` (default 200, replaces posts_per_page -1 in hk9_rec_query()), hk9_rec_prime_content_images(string $content), hk9_rec_settings_link($setting,$label,$fallback), hk9_rec_site_path_exists($url), hk9_rec_fragment()/hk9_rec_fragment_kses() (hero badge/meta are now kses'd — callers may still pass hk9_icon()+<span> fragments), hk9_primary_menu_objects() on wp_nav_menu_objects (sets $args->hk9_last_id). Removed: hk9_icon_brand_extras(), initAccordions() in theme.js, data-hk9-accordion attribute, wp_lazy_loading_enabled filter. Icon names: footer X now uses `x-social`; `facebook|instagram|youtube|linkedin|x-social` are sprite symbols and appear in icons.json (plugin icon picker will list them). tools/build-icons.mjs now also writes docs/licenses/LICENSE-simple-icons.txt; `npm run build:icons` is the source of truth for brand glyphs (paths embedded in BRAND_ICONS). Theme version 1.0.1 in style.css, HK9_THEME_VERSION, readme Stable tag, window.HK9.version. Nothing committed (per instructions); docs/conflict-log.md, docs/migration-map.md, docs/unresolved.md and plugin/** show as modified by other agents and were not touched by me.
